name: Horikawa Mutsumi
source:
School: 3rd year, Seiei Gakuen
Description: She is a little serious girl
Profile: The older sister of Amy, but her personality is almost the complete opposite of her sister.  She looks square and boring with her glasses, but they also give her an intelligent look.  She has a serious attitude towards romance and she believes that love is something you nurture.
